Queensborough homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Queensborough, September 2026. Detached houses: 41 listed at month end and 1 sold in September, a sales ratio of 2% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 72 listed at month end and 9 sold in September, a sales ratio of 13% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 8 sold over 4 months against an average of 34.2 listed, about 17.1 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 5 sold. faq.q: How does Queensborough connect to the rest of New Westminster?
faq.a: By Highway 91A, the Queensborough Connector, over the Queensborough Bridge across the North Arm of the Fraser River to Marine Way / Stewardson Way; Highway 91 connects at the south end in Richmond.

faq.q: What sold in Queensborough in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached: 1 sold from 41 listings (2% sales ratio); condos & townhomes: 9 solds from 72 listings (13%). At the New Westminster community level the detached median sale price was $1,365,000 and the condos & townhomes median was $560,000 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

Yes — it is Floodplain Zone 1 in the City's study, a low-lying area with high groundwater and poor drainage protected by a perimeter dyke built in the 1960s covering about 350 hectares and a pumped drainage system shared with Richmond; new construction must meet flood construction levels of 3.53 m (Area A) or 4.20 m (Area B) above GSC datum.

faq.q: Which schools are on the island?
faq.a: Queen Elizabeth Elementary and Queensborough Middle School, 833 Salter Street, are in Queensborough; for the sample address 921 Salter Street the SD40 locator result is Queen Elizabeth Elementary (K–4), Queensborough Middle (5–8) and New Westminster Secondary (9–12) on the mainland.
